title: Blacksmith Forging Blue Crystal
description: A hooded blacksmith stands at an anvil holding a hammer in one hand while the other touches a paper with marks and drawings. With tongs in a large gloved hand a glowing blue crystal is held above the anvil as blue liquid drips from it and from a large circular device hanging above covered in painted marks and runes. The stone walls are covered in painted marks and runes with blue birds and feathers scattered around. The scene uses dark blues, glowing cyan, brown, and gray stone colors.
